info.title: ChronoPay API
info.description: API for ChronoPay payment and scheduling platform

get.description: Returns a paginated list of slots normalized to the buyer's resolved timezone. Timezone resolution uses the buyer profile (when present), then the `x-timezone` header, then UTC. The `X-Cache` response header reports whether the page was served from cache.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page.

parameters.name: x-timezone
parameters.description: IANA timezone used to render slot times. Invalid values return 400.

400.description: Invalid pagination parameters or timezone header

post.description: Creates a new bookable slot. Times accept either Unix epoch milliseconds or ISO-8601 strings. The range must be positive, at most 24 hours long, and `endTime` must be greater than `startTime`. Requires a valid API key and the `CREATE_SLOT` feature flag.

startTime.description: Start time as Unix epoch milliseconds or an ISO-8601 string.

endTime.description: End time as Unix epoch milliseconds or an ISO-8601 string.

400.description: Malformed request body or `endTime` is not greater than `startTime`.

403.description: Invalid API key or endpoint not allowed for the partner tier

422.description: A time value is malformed, the duration exceeds 24 hours, or the slot fails service-side validation.

503.description: The CREATE_SLOT feature flag is disabled

get.description: Returns a single slot normalized to the buyer's resolved timezone. The `X-Cache` response header reports whether the slot came from cache.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Slot id. Either a canonical `slot-<uuid>` identifier or a positive integer legacy id.

parameters.name: x-timezone
parameters.description: IANA timezone used to render slot times. Invalid values return 400.

400.description: Invalid slot id or timezone header

patch.description: Updates an existing slot. Requires an authenticated bearer token with the `admin` role. Any subset of the mutable fields may be provided.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Slot id (canonical `slot-<uuid>` or positive integer).

startTime.description: New start time as Unix epoch milliseconds or ISO-8601 string.

endTime.description: New end time as Unix epoch milliseconds or ISO-8601 string.

validUntil.description: Unix epoch milliseconds after which the slot is no longer bookable.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired bearer token

delete.description: Deletes a slot. The caller must identify via the `x-chronopay-user-id` and `x-chronopay-role` headers, or the legacy `x-user-id` and `x-role` headers. Admins may delete any slot; other callers may delete only their own slots. The legacy header pair hides foreign slots behind a 404 instead of a 403.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Slot id (canonical `slot-<uuid>` or positive integer).

parameters.name: x-chronopay-user-id
parameters.description: Caller identity for the ChronoPay header scheme.

parameters.name: x-chronopay-role
parameters.description: Caller role for the ChronoPay header scheme (`admin` bypasses ownership).

parameters.name: x-user-id
parameters.description: Caller identity for the legacy header scheme.

parameters.name: x-role
parameters.description: Caller role for the legacy header scheme (`admin` bypasses ownership).

get.summary: List active reservations for a slot
get.description: Returns active holds (`status: held`, `expiresAt` in the future) for a slot. Only the slot's professional or an admin may read reservations.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Slot id (canonical `slot-<uuid>` or positive integer).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page.

buyerId.description: Buyer id; null when the caller is not the slot owner.

expiresAt.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the hold expires.

createdAt.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the hold was created.

400.description: Invalid slot id or pagination parameters

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired bearer token

403.description: Caller is not the slot owner and is not an admin

post.description: Creates a resale listing for a slot the caller currently owns. Supplier consent and transferability are read from the slot; callers must not send `supplierConsent` in the request body.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Slot id (canonical `slot-<uuid>` or positive integer).

expiresAt.description: Future Unix epoch milliseconds when the listing expires.

schema.description: `supplierConsent` must not be provided; it is derived from the slot record.

400.description: Invalid request body, non-positive priceFloorCents, non-future expiresAt, or caller-provided supplierConsent.

403.description: Caller is not the current slot owner, or the slot has no transferable owner

409.description: A listing already exists for this slot

422.description: Slot is not eligible for resale or supplier consent is missing

post.summary: Preview conflicts for a recurring slot series
post.description: Expands an RRULE series and reports collisions with existing slots for the same professional within the materialization horizon. The response categorizes each collision as `overlap`, `blackout`, or `tz-ambiguity` and suggests the next safe start where possible. Requires a valid API key and the `CREATE_SLOT` feature flag.

rrule.description: RRULE string with a bounded recurrence (COUNT or UNTIL).

slotDurationMs.description: Duration of each proposed occurrence in milliseconds.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone used for DST-ambiguity detection.

403.description: Invalid API key or endpoint not allowed for the partner tier

503.description: The CREATE_SLOT feature flag is disabled

get.summary: Get current quota status for the authenticated token

post.summary: Erase or preview erasure of personal data
post.description: Erases personal data for the given subject. Admins may perform live erasure or a dry-run; auditors may only request a dry-run.

subjectId.description: ID of the data subject to erase.

dryRun.description: Return the planned actions without applying mutations.

200.description: Erasure completed or dry-run plan returned.

403.description: Insufficient role or auditor attempting live erasure.

409.description: Subject is under a legal hold.

post.description: Creates a new checkout session for payment processing. Supports multiple payment methods and currencies. Optional JWT authentication; when a token is present the token subject (sub) must match customer.customerId.

amount.description: Amount in smallest currency unit (e.g., cents)

successUrl.description: Optional absolute HTTPS redirect URL on an exact configured host; HTTP allowed only outside production. Invalid values return 400 INVALID_REDIRECT_URL with details.field.

cancelUrl.description: Optional cancel redirect, subject to the same configured host and scheme policy as successUrl.

400.description: Invalid input data; redirect failures use the checkout envelope with code INVALID_REDIRECT_URL and details.field identifying successUrl or cancelUrl.

get.description: Retrieves a checkout session by ID. Requires a valid JWT; only the session owner or an admin may read the session.

post.description: Marks a checkout session as completed (payment successful). Restricted to trusted payment-provider callbacks (HMAC-signed) or admin users.

post.summary: Initiate payment for a checkout session
post.description: Initiates payment processing for a checkout session. Requires a valid JWT; only the session owner or an admin may trigger payment.
Marks a checkout session as failed (payment failed). Restricted to trusted payment-provider callbacks (HMAC-signed) or admin users.
Cancels a checkout session. Requires a valid JWT; only the session owner or an admin may cancel.

Refunds a booking intent, prorated by consumption. When MFA_REQUIRED_FOR_REFUNDS is enabled (default in production) the caller must present a fresh MFA step-up challenge bound to the authenticated subject.

parameters.name: x-chronopay-mfa
parameters.description: Fresh MFA challenge token from POST /api/v1/auth/mfa/verify. Required when MFA_REQUIRED_FOR_REFUNDS is enabled (default in production): 401 when missing or older than the freshness window, 403 when issued for a different subject.

401.description: Missing identity, or missing/expired MFA challenge

403.description: MFA challenge issued for a different subject

post.description: Promotes the NEXT webhook secret to CURRENT and moves the previous CURRENT to PREVIOUS. Requires admin token authentication plus a fresh MFA step-up challenge (subject bound to the caller, default freshness 15 minutes).

parameters.name: x-chronopay-mfa
parameters.description: Fresh MFA challenge token from POST /api/v1/auth/mfa/verify. 401 when missing or older than the freshness window, 403 when issued for a different subject.

401.description: Missing admin token, or missing/expired MFA challenge

403.description: Invalid admin token, or MFA challenge for another subject

post.description: Creates a partial refund against a completed payment session. Requires admin token authentication plus a fresh MFA step-up challenge (subject bound to the caller, default freshness 15 minutes).

parameters.name: x-chronopay-mfa
parameters.description: Fresh MFA challenge token from POST /api/v1/auth/mfa/verify. 401 when missing or older than the freshness window, 403 when issued for a different subject.

401.description: Missing admin token, or missing/expired MFA challenge

403.description: Invalid admin token, or MFA challenge for another subject

post.description: Approves a pending replay request for a failed supplier payout. The approver must be a different admin from the initiator. Requires a fresh MFA step-up challenge bound to the approving admin.

parameters.name: x-chronopay-mfa
parameters.description: Fresh MFA challenge token from POST /api/v1/auth/mfa/verify. 401 when missing or older than the freshness window, 403 when issued for a different subject.

401.description: Missing identity, or missing/expired MFA challenge

403.description: MFA challenge for another subject, or same-admin approval

post.description: Toggles the escrow paused state during migration. Requires a fresh MFA step-up challenge bound to the authenticated admin.

parameters.name: x-chronopay-mfa
parameters.description: Fresh MFA challenge token from POST /api/v1/auth/mfa/verify. 401 when missing or older than the freshness window, 403 when issued for a different subject.

401.description: Missing identity, or missing/expired MFA challenge

403.description: MFA challenge issued for a different subject

Slot.description: A bookable time slot returned by the slots API.

id.description: Slot identifier. Canonical ids are `slot-<uuid>` strings; legacy numeric ids are also accepted.

professional.description: Identifier of the professional offering the slot.

startTime.description: Start of the slot as Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC).

endTime.description: End of the slot as Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC).

startTimeLocal.description: Start time rendered in the buyer's resolved timezone. Present on list and get responses.

endTimeLocal.description: End time rendered in the buyer's resolved timezone. Present on list and get responses.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to render the local times.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Canonical error envelope returned when a request fails.
